description: [DREAL OCCITANIE] Postes de livraison éolien en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.picto-occitanie.fr. The delivery station is the connection point for wind turbines forming a wind farm (inter-wind grid) before the electricity is injected into the public grid via the source station. Some wind farms, due to their size, may have several delivery stations or even connect directly to a source station. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "[DREAL OCCITANIA] Wind delivery stations in Occitanie" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include eolien, poste de livraison. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
